import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

research = data['research_milestones']['data']
industry = data['industry_milestones']['data']
regulatory = data['regulatory_milestones']['data']
investment = data['global_ai_investment']['data']

def to_date(rec):
    return datetime(rec['year'], rec['month'], 15)

# --- Color Palette (editorial, muted but distinct) ---
COL_RESEARCH = '#2166AC'
COL_INDUSTRY = '#E08214'
COL_REGULATORY = '#B2182B'
COL_INVEST_FILL = '#D1E5F0'
COL_INVEST_LINE = '#67A9CF'
COL_CHATGPT = '#1A1A1A'
COL_BG = '#FAFAFA'
COL_GRID = '#E0E0E0'
COL_TEXT = '#333333'
COL_PRE = '#F0F0F0'
COL_POST = '#FFF8E7'

# --- Figure Setup ---
fig, ax_main = plt.subplots(figsize=(20, 11))
fig.patch.set_facecolor(COL_BG)
ax_main.set_facecolor(COL_BG)

ax_inv = ax_main.twinx()

# --- Time axis range ---
t_min = datetime(2010, 1, 1)
t_max = datetime(2025, 3, 1)
chatgpt_date = datetime(2022, 11, 15)

# --- Pre/Post ChatGPT era shading ---
ax_main.axvspan(t_min, chatgpt_date, color=COL_PRE, zorder=0, label='_nolegend_')
ax_main.axvspan(chatgpt_date, t_max, color=COL_POST, zorder=0, label='_nolegend_')

# --- Investment area chart (background) ---
inv_dates = [datetime(r['year'], 7, 1) for r in investment]
inv_values = [r['investment_bn_usd'] for r in investment]

ax_inv.fill_between(inv_dates, inv_values, alpha=0.30, color=COL_INVEST_FILL, zorder=1)
ax_inv.plot(inv_dates, inv_values, color=COL_INVEST_LINE, linewidth=2.2, zorder=2, alpha=0.85)
for i, (d, v) in enumerate(zip(inv_dates, inv_values)):
    if v >= 30 or i == 0 or i == len(inv_dates)-1:
        ax_inv.annotate(f'${v:.0f}B', xy=(d, v), fontsize=7.5, color=COL_INVEST_LINE,
                        ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold',
                        xytext=(0, 4), textcoords='offset points', zorder=3)

ax_inv.set_ylabel('Global Private AI Investment ($ Billion)', fontsize=11, color=COL_INVEST_LINE,
                   fontweight='bold', labelpad=12)
ax_inv.set_ylim(0, 160)
ax_inv.tick_params(axis='y', colors=COL_INVEST_LINE, labelsize=9)
ax_inv.spines['right'].set_color(COL_INVEST_LINE)
ax_inv.spines['right'].set_linewidth(1.2)
for spine in ['top', 'left', 'bottom']:
    ax_inv.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

# --- Track positions (y-axis) ---
Y_RESEARCH = 3
Y_INDUSTRY = 2
Y_REGULATORY = 1
track_labels = {Y_RESEARCH: 'Research\nBreakthroughs', Y_INDUSTRY: 'Industry\nAdoption', Y_REGULATORY: 'Regulatory\nAction'}
track_colors = {Y_RESEARCH: COL_RESEARCH, Y_INDUSTRY: COL_INDUSTRY, Y_REGULATORY: COL_REGULATORY}

# --- Horizontal track lines ---
for y in [Y_RESEARCH, Y_INDUSTRY, Y_REGULATORY]:
    ax_main.axhline(y=y, color=track_colors[y], linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.25, zorder=3)

# --- Plot milestones ---
def plot_milestones(records, y_base, color, marker='o', size=55):
    dates = [to_date(r) for r in records]
    ys = [y_base] * len(records)
    ax_main.scatter(dates, ys, c=color, s=size, zorder=5, marker=marker,
                    edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, alpha=0.92)
    return dates

res_dates = plot_milestones(research, Y_RESEARCH, COL_RESEARCH, marker='D', size=50)
ind_dates = plot_milestones(industry, Y_INDUSTRY, COL_INDUSTRY, marker='s', size=50)
reg_dates = plot_milestones(regulatory, Y_REGULATORY, COL_REGULATORY, marker='^', size=55)

# --- Label selected key milestones (to avoid clutter, pick notable ones) ---
def annotate_milestone(ax, rec, y_base, color, offset_y, fontsize=7, ha='center', bold=False):
    d = to_date(rec)
    short = rec['event']
    if len(short) > 40:
        short = short[:37] + '...'
    weight = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    ax.annotate(short, xy=(d, y_base), fontsize=fontsize, color=color,
                ha=ha, va='bottom' if offset_y > 0 else 'top',
                xytext=(0, offset_y), textcoords='offset points',
                fontweight=weight, fontstyle='normal',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', fc='white', ec='none', alpha=0.80),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, alpha=0.4, lw=0.6),
                zorder=6)

# Research labels
key_research = [
    (research[1], 18, 'center'),   # AlexNet
    (research[6], 18, 'center'),   # Transformer
    (research[10], 18, 'center'),  # GPT-3
    (research[15], 20, 'center'),  # ChatGPT
    (research[16], 18, 'center'),  # GPT-4
    (research[21], 18, 'center'),  # o1
]
for rec, off, ha in key_research:
    bold = 'ChatGPT' in rec['event']
    annotate_milestone(ax_main, rec, Y_RESEARCH, COL_RESEARCH, off, fontsize=7, ha=ha, bold=bold)

# Industry labels
key_industry = [
    (industry[0], -18, 'center'),   # Siri
    (industry[5], -18, 'center'),   # Google Translate
    (industry[8], 18, 'center'),    # Microsoft $1B OpenAI
    (industry[12], 18, 'center'),   # Microsoft $10B+
    (industry[15], -18, 'center'),  # NVIDIA $1T
    (industry[20], 18, 'center'),   # NVIDIA most valuable
]
for rec, off, ha in key_industry:
    annotate_milestone(ax_main, rec, Y_INDUSTRY, COL_INDUSTRY, off, fontsize=7, ha=ha)

# Regulatory labels
key_reg = [
    (regulatory[0], -18, 'center'),   # White House report
    (regulatory[6], 18, 'center'),    # EU AI Act proposed
    (regulatory[9], -18, 'center'),   # Italy bans ChatGPT
    (regulatory[13], 18, 'center'),   # Biden EO
    (regulatory[16], -18, 'center'),  # EU AI Act adopted
]
for rec, off, ha in key_reg:
    annotate_milestone(ax_main, rec, Y_REGULATORY, COL_REGULATORY, off, fontsize=7, ha=ha)

# --- ChatGPT vertical marker ---
ax_main.axvline(x=chatgpt_date, color=COL_CHATGPT, linewidth=2.2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, zorder=4)
ax_main.annotate('ChatGPT Launch\nNov 2022', xy=(chatgpt_date, 3.55), fontsize=11,
                 fontweight='bold', color=COL_CHATGPT, ha='center', va='bottom',
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', fc='#FFFFCC', ec=COL_CHATGPT, lw=1.5, alpha=0.95),
                 zorder=7)

# --- Era labels ---
ax_main.text(datetime(2016, 6, 1), 3.85, 'Pre-ChatGPT Era', fontsize=10, color='#888888',
             ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic', zorder=7)
ax_main.text(datetime(2024, 2, 1), 3.85, 'Post-ChatGPT Era', fontsize=10, color='#886600',
             ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic', zorder=7)

# --- Lag gap annotations ---
# Early lag: AlexNet 2012 → first regulation 2016 (4 years)
ax_main.annotate('', xy=(datetime(2016, 10, 15), 1.15),
                 xytext=(datetime(2012, 9, 15), 2.85),
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#999999', lw=1.5, ls='--'))
ax_main.text(datetime(2014, 9, 1), 1.75, '~4 yr gap', fontsize=8, color='#777777',
             ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white', ec='#cccccc', alpha=0.9), zorder=6)

# Late lag: ChatGPT Nov 2022 → Italy ban Mar 2023 (~4 months)
ax_main.annotate('', xy=(datetime(2023, 3, 15), 1.15),
                 xytext=(datetime(2022, 11, 15), 2.85),
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#999999', lw=1.5, ls='--'))
ax_main.text(datetime(2023, 1, 15), 1.75, '~4 mo', fontsize=8, color='#777777',
             ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white', ec='#cccccc', alpha=0.9), zorder=6)

# --- Density bracket for 2023-2024 ---
bracket_start = datetime(2023, 1, 1)
bracket_end = datetime(2024, 10, 1)
count_res = sum(1 for r in research if 2023 <= r['year'] <= 2024)
count_ind = sum(1 for r in industry if 2023 <= r['year'] <= 2024)
count_reg = sum(1 for r in regulatory if 2023 <= r['year'] <= 2024)
total_post = count_res + count_ind + count_reg
total_all = len(research) + len(industry) + len(regulatory)
ax_main.annotate(f'{total_post} of {total_all} milestones\nfall in 2023–2024',
                 xy=(datetime(2023, 10, 1), 0.45), fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
                 color='#555555', ha='center', va='center',
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', fc='#FFF3CD', ec='#FFD93D', lw=1.2, alpha=0.95),
                 zorder=7)

# --- Axes formatting ---
ax_main.set_xlim(t_min, t_max)
ax_main.set_ylim(0.2, 4.1)
ax_main.set_yticks([Y_REGULATORY, Y_INDUSTRY, Y_RESEARCH])
ax_main.set_yticklabels([track_labels[Y_REGULATORY], track_labels[Y_INDUSTRY], track_labels[Y_RESEARCH]],
                         fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
for tick_label, y_val in zip(ax_main.get_yticklabels(), [Y_REGULATORY, Y_INDUSTRY, Y_RESEARCH]):
    tick_label.set_color(track_colors[y_val])

ax_main.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
ax_main.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y'))
ax_main.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9, rotation=0)
ax_main.grid(axis='x', color=COL_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7, zorder=0)

for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax_main.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
ax_main.spines['bottom'].set_color('#AAAAAA')
ax_main.spines['left'].set_color('#AAAAAA')

# --- Legend ---
legend_elements = [
    plt.scatter([], [], c=COL_RESEARCH, marker='D', s=50, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, label='Research Breakthroughs'),
    plt.scatter([], [], c=COL_INDUSTRY, marker='s', s=50, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, label='Industry Adoption'),
    plt.scatter([], [], c=COL_REGULATORY, marker='^', s=55, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, label='Regulatory Action'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COL_INVEST_LINE, linewidth=2.2, label='AI Investment ($B)'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COL_CHATGPT, linewidth=2, linestyle='--', label='ChatGPT Launch'),
]
leg = ax_main.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=9,
                      frameon=True, fancybox=True, framealpha=0.92,
                      edgecolor='#CCCCCC', ncol=3)

# --- Title ---
fig.suptitle('The AI Acceleration: Three Tracks Converge at ChatGPT',
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color=COL_TEXT, y=0.97)
ax_main.set_title('Research breakthroughs, industry adoption, and regulatory action — 2010 to 2024\n'
                   'with global private AI investment overlay',
                   fontsize=11, color='#666666', pad=14, fontstyle='italic')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0.0, 0.02, 1.0, 0.93])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=COL_BG, edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
